name: Hungry at School
source:
Andy is terribly hungry. Having skipped some meals a day before, he left his body starved for food during school time where he can't get anything to eat. While his stomach is audibly rumbling and squeezing his insides, he sees his peers eating their food from lunchboxes in between class. Feeling desperate, he decides to ask them for help with his hunger. Will anyone help him?

[From [url=https://hidden-raisin.itch.io/hungry-at-school]itch.io[/url]]
